title: touchmark .touchmark/operations.yml
description: One-off operations of a hub that override a safeguard: rebuild a paused sync branch, propose declined content again, allow a mass close, adopt the pull requests of a multi-gitter setup. The file goes through review like packs, and only distribute on the default branch carries it out. Every entry limits itself (a branch head, a pull request number, a date), so a forgotten entry does nothing; touchmark check warns about entries past their date. Format v1.

version.description: Format version. Only 1 exists; when absent, 1 is assumed with a warning.

recreate.description: Rebuild a paused sync branch from scratch. Commits others added to it are dropped. An entry acts only while the branch head is the given commit.

head.description: Full commit id of the sync branch head to replace: 40 or 64 lowercase hex digits.

forget_declines.description: Propose again the content of a pull request the target closed without merging. touchmark marks that pull request revoked, so the entry acts once.

pr.description: Number of the declined pull request.

allow_mass_close.description: Lift the guard against closing many pull requests in one run, up to max closes, until the date.

max.description: How many pull requests a run may close.

adopt_unmarked.description: Take over the open pull requests without a marker that a multi-gitter setup opened (from known_authors, on branch_aliases), until the date.

target.description: One target repository: <provider>:<path> or <path>, as touchmark prints it.

until.description: Last day the entry is active, YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC.
